title: Preserve MIDI bank selection and bank changes
scope: Retain GP5 bank values and GPIF MSB/LSB sound definitions and ordered bank-change events.
acceptance: Preserve banks 0, 77 and 256 from upstream GP5/GP8 bank fixtures.
In bank-change.gp, retain the bank 256 event at its exact bar/position together with its program event.
Check bank ranges before conversion and keep duplicate-position event order through public editing and independent export.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage.

evidence.detail: An authored bank 256 automation disappears in GP8 export.
Covers public import, authority, fallback, validation, exact GPIF wire values, and Go reimport.
Uses pinned upstream fixtures and verifies ordered bank/program changes in Go-exported GP8.

Checked GP5 banks 0/77, GPIF banks 0/77/256, bank-change.gp at exact bar/position, duplicate-position bank/program event order, explicit-sound/channel authority, and full 14-bit boundaries. Bank edits do not imply support for unrelated controllers.

resolution: MidiChannel.Bank and TrackSound.Bank now retain the checked 14-bit MIDI bank range. GP5 track bytes and GPIF sound MSB/LSB components import without narrowing; the first explicit TrackSound is authoritative and mirrors into the channel, while MidiChannel supplies the GP8 fallback only when no explicit sound table exists. GP8 emits exact LSB/MSB components and retains SoundAutomation order, including distinct changes at the same position, so pinned AlphaTab observes each bank immediately before its program event. Invalid public and wire values are rejected with scoped diagnostics. General automation refactoring and pan, sustain, and volume changes remain outside this ticket.
